provenance.previous_result_known: The flexible DaysSinceRain + temperature + season common-environment null removed 11.4% of the existing residual but remained rejected.
provenance.rain_amount_activation_result_known: A prior separate analysis showed ERA5 72-h rainfall amount predicts strong acoustic activation beyond DaysSinceRain.
provenance.new_unread_question: Whether species-specific 72-h rainfall-amount responses reproduce the within-taxon concentration endpoint has not been evaluated before this contract.

question: Can species-specific responses to actual antecedent rainfall amount explain the residual within-taxon multi-site concentration?

population.weather_intersection: Require valid coordinate/time linkage and ERA5 72-h rainfall amount for both members of the focal pair.
population.same_sample_requirement: Recompute both the existing linear species-response comparator and the new rainfall-amount comparator on exactly this weather-eligible focal subset.

weather.source: ERA5 hourly total precipitation from the existing audited Earthmover Icechunk source and NAAMP physical SiteID coordinate file.
weather.primary_exposure: log(1 + total precipitation mm in the 72 hours ending at the greatest ERA5 hour <= local survey midpoint converted to UTC).
weather.coordinate_rule: Mean coordinate of sampled physical SiteIDs for each run.
weather.time_rule: Existing audited route-run midpoint and timezone reconstruction.

crossfit_species_model.split: Existing deterministic SHA256 route fold; each focal route is predicted by the opposite route fold.
crossfit_species_model.response: Calling-positive stop count out of 10 for each species x route-run.
crossfit_species_model.minimum_information: At least 20 positive stop cells and at least 5 positive routes in the training fold; otherwise common-environment shift is zero.
terms: cubic B-spline log(1 + 72-h rainfall mm), 4 df
cubic B-spline mean route-run air temperature, 4 df
log(1 + DaysSinceRain) x log(1 + 72-h rainfall mm)
log(1 + 72-h rainfall mm) x mean temperature

null_construction.site_structure: Strictly-prior species x physical-SiteID probability plus a=0.75 dry-state persistence.
null_construction.environment_shift: For each species and focal pair, add the cross-fitted predicted wet-run minus dry-run environmental logit shift to every stop.
null_construction.magnitude: Solve one pair-level common logit shift so expected total wet incidence equals observed.
null_construction.conditioning: Condition concentration on simulated route-new-taxon and total extra-stop rainfall coefficients with the existing null-regression residual method.

comparison.baseline: Re-run the existing cross-fitted linear DaysSinceRain species-response + prior-history + dry-persistence comparator on the same ERA5-eligible focal subset.
comparison.primary_quantity: Fractional reduction in observed conditional residual from same-sample baseline to rainfall-amount common-environment null.

decision.sufficient: Observed rainfall-amount-null residual is within its 95% null residual interval.
decision.insufficient: Observed residual remains above the rainfall-amount-null upper 95% bound.

boundaries: This is post-hoc exploratory sensitivity, not independent confirmation.
Rejection does not identify social facilitation or synchronous breeding.
ERA5 precipitation is not local hydrology; hydroperiod, water level and other shared environmental triggers can remain unmeasured.
No tuning of 72-h window, spline df, interactions, sample rules, tail or simulation conditioning after endpoint readback.
